annotations.title: Buy a Robinhood Chain token (agent trading)

description: Buy a Robinhood Chain token with ETH from the member's PumpPill trade bot wallet. Needs the member's agent key (X-Agent-Key: ppa_..., made in PumpPill's Telegram trade bot under Settings, AI agent). PumpPill reads the token first and, unless the member turned refusal off, refuses a HIGH/CRITICAL read or a token it has not read, saying why. The member's own limits apply. The order is written down before it is placed; poll agent_order for the result. Moves real money: confirm the token and size with the member first.
name: agent_buy
